A '''grayish-brown-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]''' found within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] like [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Gormaanda/Legends|Gormaanda]] was a member of this species.<ref name="TSWHS" />

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], they possessed relatively [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] features, with [[Color/Legends|grayish-brown]] skin, gray [[Hair/Legends|hair]], yellow [[Eye/Legends|eye]]s, and four [[Limb/Legends|arms]].<ref name="TSWHS" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="tt">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15778940|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-12|time=6:13 PM|quote=Wookiee Life Day occurs every 3 years, one of which fell at ~1.5 ABY.}}</ref> a member of this species, [[Gormaanda/Legends|Gormaanda]], had become a renowned [[Chef/Legends|chef]], being rated four-stars, winning the [[Orto Culinary Academy Award for Engorgable Excellence]] three times, [[Author/Legends|authoring]] the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[Travels with Gormaanda: Cooking in the Core]]'', creating the a [[Gormaanda's Culinary Corner]] cooking column for [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], and recording widely distributed [[Instruction cassette|instructional cooking cassettes]].<ref name="TSWHS" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species made their debut within ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'',<ref name="TSWHS" /> which released on [[November 17]], [[1978]].<ref name="Boba Fett: Mystery Man">{{GalaxyCite|1|Boba Fett: Mystery Man in Not-So-Shining Armor}}</ref>
